limitations: Formal component properties omit weight while the official operation examples and weighted-goods article explicitly support it. This subset does not claim a complete Swagger download.
New or edited weight remains unsupported without a verified unit contract; only unchanged fresh provider values are preserved.
Country values require a separate operation; not inferred.
Missing fresh weight or grouping remains UNKNOWN and blocks affected mutation; no compensating write or automatic replay.
Exemplar values are never included inline in ship-v4.

weight.read: v6 create-or-get and v5 status official examples; official Ozon weighted-goods article445
weight.unit: unspecified; do not measure, convert, invent or accept merchant edits
weight.rule: exact unchanged provider-observed numeric value per SKU and exemplar ID, freshly equal v5 status; missing/null/zero are distinct

multi_box_qty.read: v6 create-or-get int32 and separate fresh v3 posting/get.result.multi_box_qty int32
multi_box_qty.rule: same known count only; freeze it in posting and packing fingerprints; reject merchant edits and missing fresh evidence
